captions.text: A sine wave contains one ideal frequency.
Square and sawtooth waves contain additional harmonics,
giving them different timbres at the same fundamental.
The shape of a cycle therefore matters even when its repetition rate stays fixed.
Listen to each briefly and compare the visible edges and slopes.
